blocks.label: Accordion
blocks.description: Questions that open to show their answers — FAQs, details, policies.
blocks.aiHint: children are accordion-item blocks (title + answer). single true closes the others when one opens.

props.html: Most orders are ready within a week.
Yes — up to a day before, at no cost.
We deliver across the city; elsewhere by post.

blocks.label: Question
blocks.description: One row of an accordion: a title that opens to show its content.
blocks.aiHint: Only inside accordion. title is the question; children hold the answer (usually one text block).

props.html: The answer, in a sentence or two.

blocks.label: Badge
blocks.description: A small label — “New”, “Popular”, “Sold out”.
blocks.aiHint: One or two words. tone primary for highlights, muted for tags; variant soft by default.

blocks.label: Breadcrumbs
blocks.description: Home › Section › This page — the trail to the page, from its address.
blocks.aiHint: Built from the page path and page names; put it at the top of inner pages.

blocks.label: Button
blocks.description: A call to action: goes to a page or link, or opens a modal, drawer or widget.
blocks.aiHint: One "primary" button per section, others "outline" or "ghost". Set node.action (link / page / open / scroll / widget).

blocks.label: Card
blocks.description: A box that groups a picture, text and buttons. The whole card can be a link.
blocks.aiHint: For features, products, posts, team members, prices. Children in order: optional image (edge to edge when it comes first), then heading / text / buttons. If node.action is set the whole card is the link — then don’t put buttons in it.

blocks.label: Carousel
blocks.description: A row of slides people swipe or step through with arrows — pictures, cards, quotes.
blocks.aiHint: Each child is one slide (image, card, quote…). perView sets how many show at once on desktop; phones show one and a peek of the next.

blocks.label: List of records
blocks.description: Shows records from one of the project’s models — services, team, products, posts — or the cards kept in a Contents record, drawn with the blocks inside it, once per record.
blocks.aiHint: For anything that repeats and grows (services, team, products, posts, testimonials): props.source = { model: "<route>", sort: "-createdAt", pageSize: 12, filter: { featured: true } } names a model whose public API has list. Its children are the item template, drawn once per record; inside it bind props to the record with bind: { text: { from: "item", field: "title" } } or write "{{item.title}}" in text. slots.empty shows when there are no records. For a section of cards (features, team, reviews, numbers) without a model of its own: props.source = { content: "<slug>" } names a Contents record of category "card" whose card list (title, subTitle, description, image) are the items — the builder makes these itself when a section is added.

props.label: Records
props.help: The model, its order, how many and which ones.

props.label: Show pages
props.help: Previous / next links when there are more records than fit.

blocks.label: Container
blocks.description: Keeps its content to a maximum width, centred.
blocks.aiHint: Use inside a full-width section to narrow a column of content (e.g. prose at "sm").

blocks.label: Countdown
blocks.description: Days, hours, minutes and seconds until a date — a launch, a sale, an event.
blocks.aiHint: to is an ISO date-time with the business’s offset, e.g. "2026-12-24T18:00:00+06:00". endedText shows once it has passed.

blocks.label: Divider
blocks.description: A thin horizontal line.
blocks.aiHint: Separates groups of content, e.g. above a footer’s copyright line.

blocks.label: Drawer
blocks.description: A panel that slides in from the side, opened by a button or link — menus, carts, filters.
blocks.aiHint: A side panel. Put it at the top level of the page; open it with { type: "open", target: <this id> } on a button. side "left" for menus, "right" for carts and details.

props.label: Name for screen readers
props.help: Read out when it opens; not shown.

blocks.label: Embed
blocks.description: Shows a map or player from an allowed site (Google Maps, YouTube, Vimeo) by its embed link.
blocks.aiHint: Only for embed URLs from manifest.embeds (e.g. a Google Maps "Embed a map" link). No other sites or custom HTML.

props.label: Embed link
props.help: The src of the embed code — Google Maps → Share → Embed a map.

blocks.label: Contact form
blocks.description: Name, email and message fields. Until built-in forms arrive, sending opens the visitor’s email app, addressed to you.
blocks.aiHint: kind "contact" (name, email, message) or "newsletter" (email only, inline). Sends to the site’s email from Website settings. Real form handling comes later (W-08).

props.label: Send to
props.help: Leave empty to use the email in Website settings.

blocks.label: Gallery
blocks.description: A grid of pictures; a click opens them big, one by one.
blocks.aiHint: items [{ src, alt, caption? }] — media URLs or placeholders; always write alt text. 6–12 pictures.

blocks.label: Grid
blocks.description: Lays its content out in equal columns — fewer on smaller screens.
blocks.aiHint: For cards, features, logos and galleries: columns on desktop, columnsTablet and columnsMobile for smaller screens.

blocks.label: Header
blocks.description: The top of every page: logo, menu and buttons. On phones the menu folds into a ☰ button.
blocks.aiHint: Put one in the layout header. Logo + name come from Website settings, the menu from pages marked showInMenu (source "site"). Children are the buttons on the right (1–2 buttons). layout "split" | "center" | "stacked".

props.label: Links from
props.help: “Pages in the menu” follows each page’s “Show in the menu” setting.

props.label: Links
props.help: Used when “Links from” is “These links”.

props.label: Stays at the top when scrolling

blocks.label: Heading
blocks.description: A title. Level 1 once per page, then 2–4 in order.
blocks.aiHint: level 1 for the page title (once), 2 for section titles, 3–4 below them. Keep it short; size "auto" follows the level.

blocks.label: Icon
blocks.description: An icon from the built-in set, in the text colour.
blocks.aiHint: Pick a name from manifest.icons. Colour follows style.color; add a label only when the icon means something on its own.

props.label: Label for screen readers
props.help: Leave empty when the icon is decoration next to text.

blocks.label: Image
blocks.description: A picture from your media library, optionally cropped to a shape.
blocks.aiHint: src is a media-library URL or "placeholder:<w>x<h>:<label>" when no picture exists yet. Always write a short alt text describing the picture.

props.label: Alt text
props.help: Describes the picture for screen readers and search engines.

props.label: Load first
props.help: Turn on for the big picture at the top of a page.

blocks.label: Link
blocks.description: A text link to a page, another site, an email address or a phone number.
blocks.aiHint: Inline navigation (menus, footers). Set node.action to { type: "link", href } or { type: "page", pageId }.

blocks.label: Logo
blocks.description: Your logo and/or site name from Website settings, linking to the home page.
blocks.aiHint: The site’s logo and name (from Website settings unless set here). Links home unless node.action says otherwise.

props.label: Logo
props.help: Leave empty to use the logo from Website settings.

props.label: Name
props.help: Leave empty to use the site name from Website settings.

blocks.label: Map
blocks.description: A Google map of your address from Website settings (or one you type here).
blocks.aiHint: Shows the site’s address (Website settings → Contact) unless address is set. No API key needed.

props.label: Address
props.help: Leave empty to use the address in Website settings.

blocks.label: Moving strip
blocks.description: A strip that slowly scrolls sideways — customer logos, press mentions. Stops for people who prefer less motion.
blocks.aiHint: Children are logos (image blocks, small) or short text. 5–10 items. Stands still with prefers-reduced-motion.

blocks.label: Pop-up
blocks.description: A window over the page, opened by a button or link. Closes with its × button, Esc or a click outside.
blocks.aiHint: A modal dialog. Put it at the top level of the page; open it with a button whose action is { type: "open", target: <this id> }. Hidden until opened. Good for sign-up forms, video, details.

props.label: Name for screen readers
props.help: Read out when it opens; not shown.

blocks.label: Menu
blocks.description: A row or column of links — your pages marked “Show in the menu”, or links you choose.
blocks.aiHint: source "site" lists the pages marked showInMenu (preferred); "custom" uses items [{ label, href }]. direction "row" for headers, "column" for footers.

props.label: Links from
props.help: “Pages in the menu” follows each page’s “Show in the menu” setting.

props.label: Links
props.help: Used when “Links from” is “These links”.

blocks.label: Popover
blocks.description: A small panel that opens just below the button or link that opens it. Closes with Esc or a click elsewhere.
blocks.aiHint: A small floating panel under its trigger. Put it at the top level of the page; a button with { type: "toggle", target: <this id> } opens and closes it. For short menus, hints and details.

props.label: Name for screen readers
props.help: Read out when it opens; not shown.

blocks.label: Quote
blocks.description: What a customer said, with their name, role and photo.
blocks.aiHint: Testimonials: text in the customer’s words (1–3 sentences), author, role ("Owner, Café Nord"). rating 0 hides the stars.

props.label: Quote
props.default: They were quick, friendly and the result was better than we hoped.

props.text: They were quick, friendly and the result was better than we hoped.

blocks.label: Section
blocks.description: A full-width band of the page with its content kept to a readable width.
blocks.aiHint: Top-level building block of a page: one per band (hero, features, footer…). Set a background with style.bgColor / bgImage; put a stack or grid inside.

blocks.label: Saved section
blocks.description: A section saved in Design. It looks the same everywhere it’s used — change it once and every page follows.
blocks.aiHint: Places a saved (global) section by its id from the design’s sections. To change what it shows, edit the saved section, not this block.

blocks.label: Social links
blocks.description: Icons linking to your social profiles — from Website settings, or links you add here.
blocks.aiHint: source "site" uses the profiles in Website settings (preferred); "custom" uses items [{ network, url }].

props.label: Profiles
props.help: Used when “Links from” is “These links”.

blocks.label: Spacer
blocks.description: Empty space of a fixed height.
blocks.aiHint: Prefer gaps and padding; use a spacer only for a one-off extra gap.

blocks.label: Stack
blocks.description: Lines its content up in a row or a column with even gaps.
blocks.aiHint: Flexbox. direction "column" for vertical lists of text and buttons, "row" for button groups and side-by-side content; stackOnMobile turns a row into a column on phones.

props.label: Column on phones
props.help: A row becomes a column below 768 px.

blocks.label: Number
blocks.description: A big number with a label — “12 years”, “4.9 ★”, “2,000 customers”.
blocks.aiHint: value is short ("98%", "12k+"); label says what it counts. Use 3–4 in a grid.

blocks.label: Tab
blocks.description: One tab of a Tabs block: its title and what shows when it’s chosen.
blocks.aiHint: Only inside tabs. label is the tab’s title; children are its content.

blocks.label: Tabs
blocks.description: Content in tabs: visitors pick a title to see its part. Each tab is a block inside.
blocks.aiHint: children are tab blocks (2–6), each with a short label. For services, menus by meal, plans by audience.

blocks.label: Text
blocks.description: Paragraphs with bold, italics, links and lists.
blocks.aiHint:
Body copy as simple HTML:

, , , ,

    /
      /
    1. ,

      –

      ,
      , . Nothing else survives.

blocks.label: Video
blocks.description: A YouTube or Vimeo video, or a video file from your media library.
blocks.aiHint: url: a YouTube / Vimeo link or an .mp4/.webm file URL. Files can autoplay muted on a loop (background-style).

themes.label: Bistro
themes.description: Warm and inviting — wine red, brass and cream with classic serif headings. Made for restaurants and bars.

themes.label: Bright
themes.description: Friendly and colourful — violet and coral, round corners and pill buttons. Suits apps, shops and classes.

themes.label: Calm
themes.description: Soft and unhurried — sage, sand and gentle serif headings. Suits bookings, wellness and care.

themes.label: Editorial
themes.description: Warm and literary — paper tones, a terracotta accent and serif type. Suits writers, studios and restaurants.

themes.label: Market
themes.description: Fresh and trustworthy — deep green, warm amber and Manrope. Made for shops and products.

themes.label: Mono
themes.description: Stark and precise — black and white, square corners and a grotesk typeface. Lets portfolio work speak.

themes.label: Studio
themes.description: Clean and modern — neutral greys, an indigo accent and Inter. Fits most business sites.
